gloss: to dive; to get into; to go underground

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {潜|もぐ}っていませんでした

definitions.explanation: Going beneath the surface of water.

definitions.gloss: to get into; to crawl into
definitions.explanation: Entering a confined space, such as getting under covers.
Figuratively hiding from authorities or evading rules.

examples.english: I dove into the sea and saw fish.

notes:
{潜|もぐ}る is an intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧).

ASPECT (ている):
The て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ form indicates either ongoing action (⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧{潜|もぐ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ = 'is diving now') or a resulting state (⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{潜|もぐ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ = 'is under the covers').

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{潜|もぐ}る (dive into the sea)
- ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{潜|もぐ}る (burrow into the futon)
- ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{潜|もぐ}る (go underwater)

WATCH OUT:
The same kanji is also read くぐる, a different verb: ⟦{潜|くぐ}る→潜る：10314_kuguru⟧ means to pass under or through (⟦トンネル→トンネル：03865_tonneru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧くぐる, ⟦{門|もん}→門：14603_mon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧くぐる), and {潜|くぐ}り{抜|ぬ}ける means to slip through (a net, a rule). Going under water or bedding is もぐる; passing under a gate or rope is くぐる.
